message.content: Given no visible neck swelling and a negative respiratory infection screen, plausible causes are noninfectious. Consider muscle tension or strain from posture, sleeping awkwardly, stress, or typing; throat irritation from dry air, mouth breathing, smoking/vaping, allergies, or vocal overuse; laryngopharyngeal reflux causing soreness and a sensation of tightness or fullness; postviral or environmental irritation without systemic infection; thyroid or salivary gland irritation without visible swelling; and anxiety/somatization. Targeted exam and history would help. Please seek urgent care if breathing trouble.
